verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipelines orchestrated through Apache Airflow, which is an extra tool, and manual triggering via the `meltano run` CLI command. The evidence never shows per-pipeline schedule definitions, cron expression syntax, or sub-hour intervals. Missing for 10: documented per-pipeline schedule configuration, explicit cron expression support, sub-hour frequency evidence, native scheduling without an external orchestrator, independent corroboration.
